$comment: Hand-authored selection input for scripts/generate-operations.mjs. This file decides WHICH spec operations the node exposes, identified by operationId, and what they are CALLED in the n8n UI. Everything else -- HTTP method, URL, parameters, types, required flags, defaults, parameter descriptions, quota pool -- is read from the OpenAPI document fetched at build time and is never written here. `rootProperty` names the response array that is split into one n8n item per record; the build fails when the spec response has no such array.
selectionRule: Every read operation that returns SEO data, across all tool tags. Excluded: all mutations that change state, request-history endpoints, saved-list, favorites, export, tag and report management, the deprecated keyword trends operation, and the legacy single-tracking lookup.
